mechanism_narrative: A negative 12-month change in the federal funds rate (indicating monetary easing) compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where the 12-month change in FEDFUNDS is negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, restrictive monetary policy increases equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) rise by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it indicates a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where both HOUST and INDPRO rise by more than 0.5% MoM (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the regime of low unemployment (UNRATE < 5%) and strong job growth (PAYEMS rising > 0.3% month-over-month), the labor market supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: low unemployment and strong job growth
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS > 0.3% MoM (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where INDPRO rises (positive MoM change) (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When annualized inflation (measured by CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals a risk of monetary tightening and reduced real equity returns, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods where CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 3.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When both residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it indicates a strong housing market and robust consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where both RSAFS and HOUST rise by more than 0.5% MoM (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the regime of strong GDP growth (GDPC1 QoQ growth > 2.0%) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL annualized inflation < 2.0%), the economy is in a 'Goldilocks' state, supporting positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 QoQ growth > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL annualized inflation < 2.0%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where GDPC1 QoQ growth > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL annualized inflation < 2.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
